headline: Knee-to-chest S swell, glassy dawn before the onshore drifts in.
today: Solid size at 3ft, fair angle and short-period, with a light W dawn making it glassy early. The onshore stays light (6-7mph) so it doesn't get wrecked, but the clean window is the first couple hours. Fish or log depending on push; ride the early tide. Fades soft and textured through the day.

daysToWatch.note: Short-period S back to 2ft-plus with a near-calm dawn — glassy early before the afternoon onshore. Loggable morning.
Dawn N offshore cleans up a waist-high fair-angle swell — small and short window, but the wind's right early.
